name: Zero2Researcher week 19 agent evaluation set
description: 20 questions with exact answers: 10 multi-step arithmetic word problems (2-3 calculator calls each) and 10 factual questions whose answers are in wiki_snippets.json (4 of them need a calculation after retrieval). Grade with zero2researcher.agents.grade(item, answer). Year-difference questions ask explicitly for the difference between two years (subtract the earlier year from the later one), so they do not depend on exact dates.

fields.gold: the answer; numbers are compared numerically (tolerance tol, default 1e-6)
fields.source: titles of the English Wikipedia articles that support the answer (lookup questions)
fields.evidence: strings a correct run must have seen in its tool outputs
fields.ref_tool_calls: tool calls in the reference agent trajectory
fields.mock: scripted behaviour of zero2researcher.agents.MockLLM (not used for grading)
